about: GTA every second (Delta, pillar 1 numbers and money). Take-Two Investor Presentation, November 2026 (posted with Q2 FY2027 results, Nov 9 2026), slide 11: Grand Theft Auto V 'Nearly 235 million units sold to date'. Take-Two counts units sold-in (shipped to stores, plus digital): its 10-Q filed Nov 9 2026 says GTA V 'has sold-in over 230 million units worldwide'. GTA V launched Sept 17, 2013. Our math: Sept 17 2013 to Nov 9 2026 = 4,801 days = 414,806,400 s; divided by 230M to 235M = one copy every 1.77 to 1.80 s on average (1.8 s); 47,907 to 48,948 a day (about 48,000). Yankee Stadium baseball capacity 46,537 (Yankees media guide via Ticketmaster/Wikipedia). GTA VI: November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S (Take-Two Q2 FY27 release, rockstargames.com/VI). Averages, not today's pace; no GTA 6 sales prediction. Sources in BRIEF.md.
